title: Sharing, Lemi Orhan Ergin
description: Everything Lemi Orhan Ergin shares in public: code on GitHub, talk recordings, the Lemi'nin Not Defteri podcast, slides, articles and social media accounts.

blocks.text: Everything I share in public, in one place: code, recordings, my podcast, slides, articles, and the accounts I post from.
My own repositories on [GitHub](https://github.com/lemiorhan). The year is when each one started.
